title: polygonum aviculare subsp. erectum
intro: Polygonum aviculare subsp. erectum, commonly known as redshank, is a plant species within the family Polygonaceae. It is known for its health benefits, which include being used to treat conditions such as diarrhea and fever due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Polygonum aviculare subsp. erectum include being a diuretic, astringent, and expectorant, which can help in treating respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
